decisive_items: Initial histopathologic findings showed a Breslow thickness of 6 mm, 14 mitotic figures/mm2
Frontal nerve biopsy: Cross section of nerve showing malignant cells with mitotic activity
response.rationale: R5 directly provides histopathologic and biopsy evidence of malignant melanoma, which is the definitive diagnosis. C1 only cites recurrence history without tissue confirmation of the disease itself, making it a weaker but compatible completion. R3 and R4 describe anatomical syndromes without identifying the underlying neoplastic cause, thus falling short as a primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Cavernous sinus syndrome is an anatomical association of the MRI finding, not the underlying malignancy; lacks direct pathological evidence.
Orbital apex syndrome is a clinical construct based on eye findings, but again does not diagnose melanoma without tissue pathology.
